summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping, registered it after the token mapping in cosmos/profiles/__init__.py, and added it to both package export lists. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim, selection (token wins on login+password; OAuth selected from extra credentials), profile output, and profile-arg override protection. Tests were not run, per instructions. Gap: the claim test checks removal of inputs only on the login/password sources, not the extra-sourced client id/secret. Changes are uncommitted.
